I will put both cow manure and some chemical fertilizer on this owned plot because the soil is tired and maize needs strength to grow well for my family. I will plant improved seed that I have kept from the previous harvest, but I will not buy pesticides or use irrigation since the rains are coming and those things cost too much money. My children and I can manage all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves on this small piece of land, working about 35 days across the season, so I do not need to hire any outside labor.
